snippet.title: THE HAMBAGU SHOP | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991140/The_Hambagu_Shop/Set in the Roaring '20s, The Sinking City 2 is a survival horror steeped in Lovecraftian dread. Defy an eldritch deity and explore the drowned alleys of Arkham, stalked by the dead, as you weigh one life against an entire city.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825860/The_Sinking_City_2/

---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
